name: Integrated Hitech Ltd
about: Incorporated in 1993, Integrated Hitech Ltd provides Software Development Services[1]
keyPoints:
Business Overview:[1]
IHT is an IT2 (Income Tax Information Technology) company which specializes
 in Income Tax software and services. It 
has its advanced software labs and training centers in Chennai and overseas subsidiaries in USA and Singapore. Company has designed and developed The Touch Screen Tax Service Kiosk, first of its kind in India, for  offices of the Chief Commissioner Of Income Tax At Bhopal, Gwalior And Jabalpur. IHT is the tax content partner to SIFY-finance portal Walletwatch and provides on line Tax Services and Tax advisory services

cons: Company has low interest coverage ratio.
The company has delivered a poor sales growth of -24.2% over past five years.
Company has a low return on equity of -20.8% over last 3 years.
